title: B2+ · L36 — Clarifying & checking understanding
description: Verificar comprension con elegancia: 'What I'm hearing is...', 'Could you elaborate on...', y clarifying questions professional.

questions.prompt: En una reunion tecnica con el VP no captas del todo un concepto que menciono al pasar.
questions.question: Which is the most professional way to ask for clarification?
options: Could you elaborate on that last point?
questions.explanation: 'Could you elaborate' es formal, especifico ('that last point'), y respetuoso — no admite ignorancia sino que pide profundizacion. Estandar en meetings profesionales anglo. Registro: profesional-cortes. Alternativas: 'would you mind expanding on that?', 'could you unpack that a bit?'. Error hispano cultural: temer preguntar por miedo a parecer poco preparado; en anglo profesional es lo contrario — los senior preguntan MAS, los junior asienten mas.
examples: Could you elaborate on the timing? I want to make sure we align on urgency. → clarifying senior
Would you mind expanding on that a bit? I'm curious about the trade-offs. → clarifying con curiosidad

questions.prompt: Antes de cerrar un acuerdo quieres verificar que ambos entienden lo mismo.
questions.question: 'Just to make sure I've got this right...' is used to:
questions.explanation: Frase check-in profesional. Anuncia parafrase — el interlocutor sabe que viene un summary y puede corregir si algo esta mal. Muy usada en meetings, negociaciones, coaching, requirements gathering. Reduce dramaticamente malentendidos costosos. Registro: profesional. Familia: 'let me confirm I've understood', 'let me check I've got this right'. Error hispano cultural: saltarse este paso por asumir comprension mutua — causa el 80% de conflictos por 'creia que habias entendido X'.
examples: Just to make sure I've got this right — you want X delivered by Y, correct? → check pre-commitment
Let me confirm I've understood: A on Monday, B on Wednesday, C by Friday? → check con schedule

questions.statement: Asking clarifying questions in a meeting shows weakness and lack of preparation.
questions.explanation: FALSO — al contrario. Clarifying questions = pensamiento critico + rigor. Rushing to nod sin entender = mucho peor: haces trabajo equivocado, se descubre despues, dana credibilidad y confianza. Los senior preguntan mas, no menos. Amazon principle: 'have backbone; disagree and commit' incluye preguntar hasta entender. Registro: profesional en cualquier nivel. Error hispano cultural: en algunas culturas hispanas preguntar puede sentirse como desafio a autoridad — en anglo profesional es signal de engagement serio.
examples: Senior: 'Quick clarifying question — what do you mean by X exactly?' → rigor senior
Junior: nods, later confused, does the wrong work, causes rework. → costo del no preguntar

questions.prompt: Un colega usa un termino tecnico ambiguo (ej: 'engagement'). Quieres definir sin sonar pedante.
questions.question: Which best invites clarification of a specific term?
options: When you say 'engagement', are you referring to time on site or DAU?
questions.explanation: 'When you say X, do you mean A or B?' = specific + options. Fuerza al hablante a definir con precision, y ademas demuestra que TU has pensado en las posibilidades. Marca de senior thinker en meetings tecnicos. Registro: profesional-tecnico. Formula clave en product, data, engineering donde jargon abunda con multiples significados. Error hispano: sonar mas cortes con generalidades cuando la precision se aprecia mas — en tecnico anglo la especificidad es respeto.
examples: When you say 'soon', are we talking days or weeks? Big difference. → temporal specificity
By 'success', do you mean revenue growth or user growth? Very different KPIs. → metric specificity

questions.text: So if I've understood correctly, the priority is shipping quickly, even at the cost of some polish?
questions.explanation: Formula clasica de verification check. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'if I've' con enlazado /ɪfaɪv/; 'understood correctly' con /dk/ cluster; 'at the cost of' con enlazado /ətðəkɒstəv/. Estructura: 'If I've understood correctly' + parafrase + verificacion implicita (?). Trade-off explicito ('even at the cost of') muestra rigor de pensamiento y hace que la respuesta sea 'yes/no' clara. Registro: profesional-senior, tipico de PM/producto senior verificando priorities.
examples: If I've heard you right, we're picking speed over quality? → priority check
So the priority is X, even if it means Y? → trade-off explicito

questions.prompt: En medio de una explicacion tecnica compleja perdiste el hilo. Quieres pedir volver atras sin frenar todo.
questions.question: 'Sorry, I want to make sure I'm following — could you back up a bit?' means:
options: Move backwards physically in the room.
Retrace or repeat what came before in the explanation.
questions.explanation: 'Back up' = volver atras en la explicacion, retomar desde un punto anterior. Muy usado cuando algo perdio el hilo o quieres verificar un supuesto. Educado y humilde, NO critica al hablante ni sugiere que su explicacion fue mala. Registro: profesional-conversacional. Alternativas: 'can we rewind for a second?', 'can we go back to X?'. Error hispano: interpretar literal como movimiento fisico; requiere reconocer uso metaforico.
examples: Sorry, back up — where did the number 40% come from? → clarifying specific
Can we back up for a second? I want to make sure I got the setup. → clarifying context

questions.prompt: Empareja cada clarifying phrase con su equivalente en espanol:

pairs.left: What do you mean by X?

questions.explanation: Set esencial de clarifying phrases de alto uso profesional. 'Bear with me' es peticion educada de paciencia mientras piensas, buscas info, o cargas algo (documento, dashboard). Ubicuo en llamadas profesionales, presentaciones, tech demos. 'Just to clarify' anuncia pregunta especifica sin sonar critico. Todos neutros US/UK, aplicables desde meeting informal a board meeting. Dominarlos es imprescindible para B2+ profesional.
examples: Bear with me while I pull up the data — my laptop is being sluggish. → excusa profesional
Just to clarify — you're asking about the Q3 numbers, not Q4? → precision temporal

questions.target: Before we move on, let me make sure I've captured this correctly — is my understanding right that we're pausing the launch until Q1?
questions.explanation: Estructura master de senior facilitator/PM: pausa proactiva ('before we move on') + verificacion ('captured this correctly') + parafrase especifica + upstream check ('is my understanding right'). Marca de senior operator que no deja moverse el grupo sin alignment verificado. Ritmo natural: pausa breve tras 'move on,', tempo mas lento en la verificacion, tono ascendente al final. Contracciones: 'I've', 'we're' obligatorias. Registro: profesional-senior. Modelo tipico de PM/facilitator experimentado.
examples: Let me check I've got this: we're pushing the launch to Q1 — correct? → check condensado
Just to make sure — the decision is to pause, not cancel? → distincion importante

questions.prompt: El VP toma una decision importante pero no explica el razonamiento. Quieres entender la logica.
questions.question: Which question best surfaces hidden assumptions behind a decision?
options: Can you walk me through the reasoning behind that?
questions.explanation: 'Walk me through the reasoning' revela la logica interna, no solo la conclusion. Uncovers assumptions ocultos y logica implicita. Muy poderoso en decisiones importantes donde entender el 'por que' es tan critico como el 'que'. Registro: profesional-senior, tipico de PM o senior IC challenging con respeto. Familia: 'help me understand the logic', 'what's the thinking behind that?'. Error hispano cultural: aceptar decisiones sin cuestionar por respeto — en anglo se valora entender el razonamiento antes de commit.
examples: Walk me through how you got to that number — I want to understand the model. → clarifying analytical
Help me understand your logic there — I might be missing something. → hedge humilde + probe

questions.statement: 'Am I making sense?' is used by speakers to check listener comprehension during complex explanations.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Am I making sense?' = pregunta comun de speakers ante concepto complejo o abstracto. Verifica sin condescender ni sugerir que el listener es lento. Registro: profesional-conversacional. Alternativas: 'is this landing?', 'following me so far?', 'does that track?'. Uso pedagogico: teachers, coaches, technical explainers la usan constantemente. Error hispano: preferir preguntas mas directas al listener ('do you understand?') — 'am I making sense?' es superior porque pone la responsabilidad en el speaker, no en el listener.
examples: That's a lot to take in — am I making sense? Any questions? → check pedagogico
Does that track? I know it's dense — happy to slow down. → check + oferta

questions.prompt: En un kickoff de proyecto quieres verificar que todos comparten la misma vision antes de arrancar.
questions.question: 'I want to make sure we're on the same page about X' means:
options: Literally reading the same book together.
Confirming shared understanding and alignment on X.
Physically turning to the same page.
A rhetorical question with no answer expected.
questions.explanation: 'On the same page' = alineados en entendimiento, expectativas, prioridades. Ubicuo en business anglo, preludio tipico a summary de expectativas o decisiones. Metafora clara: si todos estamos leyendo la misma pagina, estamos en el mismo contexto. Registro: profesional-corporate. Uso practico: prevenir malentendidos costosos verificando alignment antes de execution. Error hispano: interpretar literal; requiere reconocer uso metaforico. Colocacion fija: 'on THE same page' (con articulo).
examples: Before we go further, let's make sure we're on the same page about scope. → alignment pre-work
Are we on the same page about the deadline? I want to avoid surprises. → verification directa

questions.text: I want to check something — when you say 'as soon as possible', do we have a specific target date in mind?
questions.explanation: Question la vaguedad tipica del business speak. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'want to check' con /tʧ/ cluster asimilado; 'as soon as possible' → ASAP se pronuncia letra por letra /ˌeɪˈsæp/ o como palabra /ˈeɪsæp/; 'target date' con /td/ cluster, la /t/ se debilita. 'As soon as possible' es trampa comun: cada persona interpreta diferente. Preguntar por target especifico previene missed expectations. Rigor de PM/producto senior. Registro: profesional-tecnico.
examples: 'ASAP' is not a deadline — what's the real date? → challenge a vaguedad
When you say 'soon', help me understand what soon means to you. → clarifying via reflection

questions.prompt: En una sesion de coaching quieres invitar a tu cliente a expandir sobre algo que menciono.
questions.question: 'Could you say more about that?' works because it:
options: Is open-ended and invites expansion without judgment.
Is short and doesn't take time.
questions.explanation: 'Say more about that' = pregunta abierta pura, no judgment, invita expandir en la direccion que quiera el hablante. Herramienta central de coaching moderno. Genera 3x mas informacion que preguntas cerradas o especificas. Registro: coaching, therapy, empathetic listening. Familia: 'tell me more', 'what else?', 'go on'. Error hispano cultural: preferir preguntas mas dirigidas por temor a parecer vago; la vaguedad intencional es lo que da poder a esta pregunta.
examples: Say more about that — I'm interested where it goes. → open coaching invitation
Could you say more about what led to that decision? → open + focused

questions.statement: 'Correct me if I'm wrong, but I understood X' is a soft way to check understanding while inviting correction.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Formula humilde + verificadora. Baja stakes de estar equivocado y hace facil al otro corregir sin friction relacional. Ideal en salas politicas o con superiores donde no quieres afirmar tajantemente. Registro: profesional-diplomatico. Doble funcion: (1) verifica tu entendimiento, (2) da al otro permiso explicito para corregirte sin sentir que te contradice. Muy usado en meetings, negotiations, board contexts. Error hispano cultural: sonar demasiado seguro puede leerse como agresivo — este hedge es lubricante social.
examples: Correct me if I'm wrong — the deadline was Friday, right? → verification suave
Correct me if I've misunderstood — we're on hold, correct? → verification importante

questions.target: Just to make sure we're aligned — the decision is to pilot with one team first, measure results, and then scale. Is that a fair summary?
questions.explanation: Formula perfecta de senior facilitator alignment check: 'aligned' + parafrase completa (3 pasos: pilot, measure, scale) + 'fair summary' invita adjustment sin forzar aprobacion. Marca de PM/facilitator experimentado cerrando alignment antes de execution. Ritmo natural: pausa breve tras 'aligned —', enumeracion clara de tres pasos, tono ascendente y calmado en 'fair summary?'. Contracciones: 'we're' obligatoria. Registro: profesional-senior, ideal para wrap-ups de meetings importantes.
examples: Let me summarize where we've landed and check nothing's missing. → alignment cierre
Fair summary: X, then Y, then Z. Anything to add or adjust? → apertura a input
